Etym. M. p. 595, 40 βουλευτής βούλευτις [counsellor, counsellor (feminine)]. “τῶνδε βούλευτις πόνων” [counsellor of these toils] in the Xantriae (fr. 166), where it is uncertain whether Aeschylus's or (which is less probable) the comic poet Plato's Xantriae are meant. Lobeck discussed the form of the word in his commentary on Phrynichus p. 256.
